brief:
Settlers attacked water infrastructure in the village of Yarza, east of Tubas, according to Shehab Wire. Video footage documented the assault on the water lines serving the Palestinian community. The incident reflects ongoing tensions over resources in the Jordan Valley region of the occupied West Bank.

The attack on water systems comes as Palestinian villages in the area face severe constraints on water access. Tubas district has experienced repeated incidents of settler violence targeting civilian infrastructure and agricultural resources. Such attacks have disrupted essential services for local residents who already operate under significant restrictions on water supply and development in the territory.
